stories.label: Iran war Day 17: Supreme leader safe, Dubai airport hit by drones, GCC leverage question
stories.summary: Day 17. Mojtaba Khamenei confirmed safe — Israel's leadership-pressure strategy requires intensification. Two drones came down near Dubai International Airport (world's busiest by international passengers), injuring four. Gulf Arab states face mounting popular pressure to use oil as leverage but are trapped by US military dependency. Oil crashed 15% on 'de-escalation hopes' — origins of those hopes unclear; IEA reserve release being discussed. War has now reached civilian aviation infrastructure in the UAE.

stories.label: Hormuz: oil plunges 15% on 'hopes'; IEA release; India-US energy pivot; Africa insulated unevenly
stories.summary: Oil crashed 15% on de-escalation 'hopes' — whiplash after Iran declared blockade indefinite. IEA strategic reserve release being signalled, which would confirm this is a 1973-scale supply crisis. Trump personally promoting US oil deal with India's Reliance Industries — India being drawn into US energy sphere. South Africa confirmed largely insulated (imports from Nigeria/Atlantic, not Gulf), revealing Africa's uneven exposure. Algeria actively procuring wheat. Sweden Democrats proposing household energy compensation — Iran war shaping European domestic politics.

stories.label: Lebanon: Israeli strike on Beirut apartment; 700K+ displaced; France UNSC resolution pending
stories.summary: Beirut apartment block struck this cycle. 700,000+ total displaced; 394 killed in one week including 83 children. Israel simultaneously bombing Iran and intensifying Lebanon offensive — two-front war. France's UNSC emergency session outcome still unknown; US veto likely. White phosphorus used in populated areas (HRW confirmed). Lebanon has delayed elections by two years.

stories.label: Yann LeCun raises $1B to build world-model AI — scientific challenge to LLM paradigm
stories.summary: Turing Award winner LeCun (Meta's chief AI scientist) raising $1B to build AI that learns predictive models of the physical world — his scientific argument is that LLMs cannot achieve general intelligence because they process only language, not physical reality. The $1B raise means serious investors agree. This is a scientific paradigm challenge, not just a product launch.

Both sides treating war as temporary interruption to planned tech expansion. Post-war Gulf economy is being designed around AI infrastructure.

This challenges BYD's undisputed champion narrative and raises questions about who ultimately wins the global EV race.

North African governments front-running potential food supply shocks — bread price stability is a political survival issue. Watch Egypt, Tunisia, Morocco for similar procurement moves.

stories.label: Presolar crystals in meteorites reveal the solar system's formation from dead stars
stories.summary: Quanta Magazine feature on pre-solar grains — microscopic crystals that formed inside other stars before the Sun existed, preserved in meteorites. The closest science can get to seeing the pre-solar universe. Confirms we are made of stellar debris from stars that exploded before the Sun lit up.
